{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Zant's Helmet Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Zant's Helmet Model.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Zant's Helmet Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Zant's Helmet Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |type= Armor |game= BotW, TotK |other= HW |cost= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 50 [[Rupee]]s |TotK= 400 [[Poe]]s }} |value= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 15 Rupees }} |location= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= [[Tobio's Hollow]] |TotK= [[Scorching Coliseum]] }} |uses= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= Increasing Link's defense, Unfreezable |HW= Purchasing [[Badge]]s }} |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 3 }} |durability= |comp= {{List| * [[Zant Mask]] * [[Zant's Magic Gem]] }} |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Zant's Helmet|Zant's Helmets|Series, BotW, TotK, HW, HWL, HWDE}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, HW, HWL, HWDE}} also known as the '''Usurper King's Helmet''',{{Exp Game|BotW}} is a recurring [[Item]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Descriptions BotW}} Zant's Helmet is a piece of [[Armor]] introduced in the "[[EX Treasure: Usurper King]]" [[Side Quest]] from [[The Champions' Ballad]] Downloadable Content pack. It is a priceless relic that was once kept safely within the walls of [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]], but was later stolen by [[Misko]]. Misko hints at the whereabouts of Zant's Helmet in [[Misko's EX Journal 2]] in the [[Deya Village Ruins]], claiming that it rests among dead [[Tree]]s in [[Tobio's Hollow]]. The [[Hidden Chest]] containing Zant's Helmet can be found between two dead Trees in the middle of a [[Bottomless Bog]] in Tobio's Hollow. In order to retrieve it, Link must use the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] to pull it from the ground. When worn, Zant's Helmet grants [[Link]] the [[Unfreezable]] bonus, preventing Link from being frozen. However, Link will still take damage from exposure to frigid environments and freezing water even while wearing Zant's Helmet. It also provides the hidden [[Added Effect]] [[Ancient Pow Up]], increasing damage done by [[Ancient Soldier Gear]] and [[Guardian Gear]] by 20%. It cannot be enhanced by a [[Great Fairy]], nor can it be [[Dye]]d at the [[Kochi Dye Shop]] in [[Hateno Village]]. Zant's Helmet is said to be much like the Helmet that [[Zant]] wore in the [[Era of Twilight]]. After initially finding Zant's Helmet, Link can purchase more from [[Granté]] in [[Tarrey Town]] for 50 [[Rupee]]s. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Descriptions TotK}} {{Stub|TotK}} Zant's Helmet is located in a [[Gloom]]-cloaked [[Treasure Chest]] in the [[Scorching Coliseum]]. It cannot be retrieved unless all of the [[Enemy|Enemies]] inside the Coliseum have been defeated. The location of Zant's Helmet is revealed by an [[Old Map]] found in the [[South Lanayru Sky Archipelago]]. Zant's Helmet can be retrieved without first finding the Old Map, however. After it has been found in the Scorching Coliseum, it can also be purchased from a [[Bargainer Statue]] for 400 [[Poe]]s. ==Other Appearances== ==={{HW|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[File:HW Zant's Helmet Icon.png|right]] In {{HW}}, Zant's Helmets are [[Gold Material]]s that can be dropped by [[Zant]] upon defeat. In {{HW|-}}, [[Agitha]] and [[Medli]] can use Zant's Helmet to create various [[Badge]]s in the [[Badge Market]]. In {{HWL}}, only Agitha can use Zant's Helmet in the Badge Market. Zant's Helmet can also be used to create various mixtures in the [[Apothecary]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW EX Treasure Usurper King.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link equipped with Zant's Helmet File:BotW Zant's Helmet Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept art of Zant's Helmet ==See Also== {{See Also| * EX Treasure: Usurper King * Zant * Zant Mask * Zant's Magic Gem }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Zant's Helmet}}
